newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort picks two more for 1997.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort picks two more for 1997.

text.p: Strategists at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson on Wednesday said they added National Grid Plc and Bass Plc to their list of preferred stocks for 1997.
Shares in Bass were up 8p at 10.23-1/2 stg by 0948 GMT while National Grid shares were up 1p at 198-1/2.
Strategist Philip Isherwood at Kleinwort said Bass should be well placed to benefit from the continued strength in consumer activity which it expects during 1997.

He said National Grid was picked because it looked the best value among utility stocks, being partly insulated from a "windfall" tax by an incoming Labour government having already at flotation paid out a 50 stg rebate to customers.

Earlier this week Kleinwort said its list of preferred stocks for 1997 included DFS Furniture Plc, Safeway Plc, TT Group Plc and Johnson Matthey Plc. The brokerage is rolling out its 1997 picks two-a-day this week.
